claims.statement: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 generally applies from 12 August 2026, requires manufacturers to establish technical documentation and a declaration of conformity for each packaging type, and requires suppliers to provide manufacturers the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity.

Direct buyer-side evidence supports a real supplier-document workflow: Bossard says it is integrating PPWR requirements into supplier due diligence and requesting compliance information, while an Oriflame packaging manager reports using a centralized platform for documents and supplier instructions.
No evidence establishes that a buyer has purchased, contracted for, or committed budget to this candidate's proposed audit or proof-vault subscription.
No signed referral, reseller, laboratory, converter, consultant, or other customer-acquisition agreement for this candidate is evidenced.

The candidate's CAC, onboarding labor, specialist-review cost, support burden, insurance, legal overhead, gross margin, conversion rate, churn, and payback assumptions have not been validated together through actual delivery and cohort data.

No executed customer subscription, supplier data-rights agreement, processing agreement, laboratory agreement, exclusivity, durable access mandate, or transferable right to packaging evidence is evidenced.

The vault faces a material cold start: useful records require customer and supplier inputs, and an entrant cannot infer authoritative composition, test, or conformity evidence solely from public information. Regulation-mandated supplier disclosure can facilitate collection but does not give this candidate automatic access.

The founder could own newly written software and schemas, but actual ownership of the proposed critical mechanism—a permissioned SKU-to-evidence dataset with supplier-response benchmarks—is unproven because no software IP provenance, populated dataset, customer permissions, or benchmark rights are evidenced.

Direct substitutes already advertise declarations, supplier tools, repositories, evidence trails, and SKU-based PPWR workflows at prices as low as €29 per month, with PPWRify offering 150 packaging units for €999 annually; this contradicts an assumption that a lightweight vault is inherently resistant to price competition.

Specright already combines packaging specifications, supplier collaboration, traceability, approvals, compliance documentation, and automated PPWR declaration reporting, demonstrating that an incumbent can bundle the proposed core workflow.

Public commercial offers demonstrate that organizations charge for PPWR work: ERP lists packages from €1,999 for a workshop and assessment through €6,999 plus €749 quarterly for ongoing implementation, while PPWR Check lists annual software packages from €5,000.

The Commission states that PPWR rules begin applying on a phased basis and that major recyclability, recycled-content, empty-space, reuse, and specified single-use restrictions apply from 2030, so immediate urgency and willingness to pay will vary by obligation and packaging portfolio.

Retention could be supported by multi-year recordkeeping, supplier changes, packaging revisions, and continuing secondary legislation, but repeat subscription demand for this candidate remains an inference rather than observed renewal evidence.

The control point appears obtainable only through ordinary customer and supplier contracts rather than an exclusive statutory franchise: Article 16 creates an information flow from suppliers to manufacturers, but the candidate would need customers to authorize storage, processing, reuse, and benchmarking.

The reviewed regulation permits technical documentation in electronic form and allows mandated representatives to retain and provide documentation within defined limits; it does not reveal an inherent legal prohibition on operating a contracted evidence repository, although data protection, confidentiality, security, and liability terms still require counsel.

contrary_evidence: PPWR Connect advertises overlapping compliance, declaration, evidence-trail, and portfolio functions from €29 per month, substantially below the candidate's proposed 24,000–90,000 PLN annual subscription range.
PPWRify includes a supplier tool and document repository and prices a 150-unit annual plan at €999, showing that supplier-linked document management is already directly substitutable.

Specright launched automated PPWR Declaration of Conformity reporting inside an established specification-management and supplier-collaboration platform, directly validating the incumbent-bundling risk.
The European Commission says important substantive measures phase in through 2030, contradicting any claim of uniform immediate urgency across all SKUs.

These sources contradict differentiation, pricing, and urgency assumptions; they do not establish fatality because no source proves that a narrower mid-market implementation service cannot win customers.

unknowns: Whether any target Polish or EU mid-market buyer will pay 10,000–25,000 PLN for this candidate's audit or 24,000–90,000 PLN annually for its vault.
Actual conversion rate from readiness audit to subscription, sales-cycle duration, CAC, payback, churn, renewal, expansion, and contribution margin.
The number of target buyers lacking adequate PLM, specification-management, supplier-portal, consultant, or low-cost PPWR software alternatives.
Supplier response rates, document completeness, document accuracy, refresh frequency, and willingness to permit derived benchmarks.
Whether laboratories, consultants, or converters will make referrals, on what economics, and under signed durable terms.
Ownership and provenance of future software, schemas, extracted fields, annotations, benchmarks, and AI outputs.
Customer and supplier permissions for storage, subprocessors, model use, cross-customer aggregation, benchmarking, retention, deletion, portability, and post-termination access.
Security, professional-liability, regulatory-counsel, localization, support, specialist-review, and onboarding costs at representative portfolio sizes.
Which obligations create an immediate 2026 purchase trigger for each target packaging portfolio versus requirements taking effect later.
Whether the proposed dataset develops a defensible data moat rather than remaining customer-isolated records that competitors can reproduce.

No reviewed evidence supports a fatal conclusion: illegality, an unobtainable essential right, mathematically impossible conservative economics, and non-delegable founder incompatibility are all unproven.
